The '''Department of Selkath Ethnology''' was a civil body on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] that preserved, promoted, and shared [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] culture with visitors.<ref name="TOR"/>

==History==
Formed during the wave of tourism to Manaan that happened following the [[Devastation of Manaan]], the Department shared, preserved, and promoted Selkath culture by employing docents, lecturers, curators, and field guides who welcomed and educated interested tourists. At some point the [[Manaan Visitor's Center]] was constructed, and the [[Exploration Dome]], the crown jewel of the department, was constructed underneath it.<ref name="TOR"/>
